description: Permissions spotcheck on ambiguous commercial pages. heuristic = derive_permissions only. llm_independent = prior 3rd-party LABEL_GUIDE labels (no Anti-GEO rule-base). llm_rulebase = Azure hybrid after permissions_llm._heuristic_rules_rubric. llm_suggestion_raw = raw LLM fields before merge (null = keep heuristic).
